description: Explicit C-text predicate compilation experiment over the unchanged 1000-row fixture. The scalar integer control and existing general_text_filter retain their schedules. New equality, projection, integer sort-key, and grouping shapes use C-text comparisons; LIKE remains an unsupported control. Actual text parameter bindings are covered separately by text_diagnostics.rb.

workloads.name: general_text_filter
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(score) FROM items WHERE label >= 'row5'

workloads.name: text_equality_filter
workloads.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM items WHERE label = 'row500'

workloads.name: text_predicate_projection
workloads.sql: SELECT id, CASE WHEN label >= 'row5' THEN score + 1 ELSE score - 1 END FROM items ORDER BY id

workloads.name: text_predicate_sort
workloads.sql: SELECT id, score FROM items ORDER BY CASE WHEN label >= 'row5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, id LIMIT 20

workloads.name: text_predicate_group
workloads.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN label >= 'row5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, count(*), sum(score) FROM items GROUP BY CASE WHEN label >= 'row5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ORDER BY 1

workloads.name: text_like_fallback
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(score) FROM items WHERE label LIKE 'row5%'
